mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This meal appears to be fresh watermelon, a fruit with high water content and a modest carbohydrate load per small serving. Its glycemic effect can still raise blood sugar levels in someone with diabetes if eaten in larger portions, so it is best to avoid or strictly limit large servings of this meal, opting for a high-fiber fruit such as berries instead.
mealAnalysis.meal_description: Three small pieces of fresh watermelon served plain.
